bug_semantics: PUT /api/echo/like/:id is registered on PublicRouterGroup with no JWT, no rate limit, and no (IP, echoID) dedup. LikeEcho exists-check then fav_count++ (later also cache invalidation). Unauthenticated callers can inflate any echo's fav_count, including private echoes whose UUIDs leak from GET /api/echo/page, and can amplify DB/cache load. CWE-770. CVE-2026-79661 remains PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn).
